title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I have 2 sons aged 3.5 and 8 yrs. About 2-3 months ago, my wife saw a dream that she is hitting our elder son with a thick stick like object on the head. She is crying and does not want to hit him but she is continuing to hit him. Due to some reason, she is unable to stop hitting him. About a week ago I saw a similar dream about my elder son with the difference that I am hitting him all over his body with my hand. I am trying to him even harder but my strikes are not turning out to be very hard despite my attempts. He is a very beautiful and obedient child. He does tend to be very mischievous at times, but it is easily controlled by us. We are very worried about these strange dreams. Please interpret this dreams for us. Jazakallahukhaire. 1519 views Q. I am inquiring about the interpretation of a dream that I saw: I?m walking with my mother on a pathway, and she supposedly is carrying my child. In my dream I think to myself, how that is possible, as I am not married nor have I committed the haram (zina). Later when I arrive home, the child is alone with me: his name is Idrees, and he is so beautiful that for a second I wonder if he is a girl: The child is very healthy, white skinned, has blond hair, and with colorful (very light green, close to blue) eyes. Then I think if he is my child, then I will be able to breastfeed him because I should have milk in my breasts. I offer my left breast, and the baby accepts? then I try my right breast, and again he accepts. I quickly stop, and kiss the child?s mouth? then I woke up. 1731 views Q. asalamualaykum mufti sahab, I had seen a dream. Time was after fajr.
